objects.name: account_positions
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE account_positions (
                Position_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                Security_Type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(Security_Type IN ('Equity', 'Currency', 'Swap', 'Bond', 'Future')),
                Local_Currency TEXT NOT NULL,
                Account_No TEXT NOT NULL,
                Maturity_Year INTEGER,
                Market_Value REAL NOT NULL,
                Quantity REAL NOT NULL,
                Rate REAL,
                Listed_Exchange TEXT,
                Issuer_Country TEXT, Issuer TEXT, Position TEXT CHECK(Position IN ('Long', 'Short')), Security_Ticker TEXT, Security_Name TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY (Issuer_Country) REFERENCES countries(Country_Code)
            )

objects.name: companies
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE companies (
            Primary_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            Ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
            Name TEXT NOT NULL,
            Sector_FK TEXT,
            Industry_Group_FK TEXT,
            Industry_FK TEXT,
            Sub_Industry_FK TEXT, Issuer_Code TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (Sector_FK) REFERENCES sectors(Primary_ID),
            FOREIGN KEY (Industry_Group_FK) REFERENCES industry_groups(Primary_ID),
            FOREIGN KEY (Industry_FK) REFERENCES industries(Primary_ID),
            FOREIGN KEY (Sub_Industry_FK) REFERENCES sub_industries(Primary_ID)
        )

objects.name: countries
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE countries (
                Country_Code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Country_Name TEXT NOT NULL
            )

objects.name: industries
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE industries (
                Primary_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Code TEXT NOT NULL,
                Name TEXT NOT NULL
            )
rows: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

objects.name: industry_groups
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE industry_groups (
                Primary_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Code TEXT NOT NULL,
                Name TEXT NOT NULL
            )

objects.name: issuers
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE issuers (
                Issuer_Code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Party_Abbreviation TEXT NOT NULL,
                Issuer_Name TEXT NOT NULL,
                Country_Code TEXT NOT NULL,
                Party_Type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(Party_Type IN ('Ultimate Parent Issuer', 'Parent Issuer', 'Issuer', 'Sub Issuer')),
                Parent_Issuer_Code TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY (Country_Code) REFERENCES countries(Country_Code),
                FOREIGN KEY (Parent_Issuer_Code) REFERENCES issuers(Issuer_Code)
            )

constraints.definition: CHECK(Party_Type IN ('Ultimate Parent Issuer', 'Parent Issuer', 'Issuer', 'Sub Issuer'))

objects.name: Other securities
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Other securities" (
                Primary_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                Security_Name TEXT NOT NULL,
                Ticker TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                Issuer_Code TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY (Issuer_Code) REFERENCES issuers(Issuer_Code)
            )

objects.name: sectors
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sectors (
                Primary_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Code TEXT NOT NULL,
                Name TEXT NOT NULL
            )

objects.name: sub_industries
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sub_industries (
                Primary_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Code TEXT NOT NULL,
                Name TEXT NOT NULL
            )
rows: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
